section_summary.extract_value: This section (3.4) reports test-retest reliability of the BAS-2 scale across two testing sessions 3 weeks apart. For females (n=57), the intraclass correlation coefficient was .82, and for males (n=52), it was .87, with no significant differences in mean scores between sessions for either gender.
